<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Add a trace step to a result"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/result/{id}/trace"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Appends a step (`sequence`, `step_type`, `content`) to the result's trace; `sequence` numbers the steps and is unique per result. A cloud run's token may write traces of its own run tree only.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
